reviews.author: Rochelle
reviews.text: Great vibe here. Authentic Japanese flavours with incredible sauces. I had the Fried chicken bowl with spicy mayo (a hint of chipotle) served on a bed of fresh, crunchy salad and edamame beans. Chicken was super juicy and crunchy all at the same time.  Medium portions are very…

reviews.author: Jo Weir
reviews.text:
Fresh and delicious poke bowls served with a smile. I had tuna sashimi in mine, with rice, veges and lots of tasty, crunchy ingredients and there are different sauces to try.
Have a look next door in the Artist Window Gallery while you wait for your meal to be prepared. Cool…

reviews.author: Vinicius Dos Anjos
reviews.text: Amazing poke bowl, ingredients were very fresh. Great customer service too!

reviews.author: Judith Lambie
reviews.text: Loved the food. Great flavour. We enjoyed the chicken and the calamari dishes. Medium size generous and we were very full. Will definitely be back to try the other flavours.
